Results.ReviewText: Easy to use.  We love it, can't understand why it took so long to decide to get one.  Been using a Weber charcoal grill for years but the gas grill is so much better.  Fantastic.
Results.Title: Why did I take so long to get one?

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this model of grill because I previously owned a 2 burner Weber grill that served me well. The grill is built relatively well but obviously not as heavy duty as my last. The overall grill top space is plentiful for our needs. One of the things I really love about this grill is the igniter. It is effortless. One of the reasons i purchased this model is my former unit had a lower compartment with a door and I thought it was nice to have this space and in this case it houses the LP tank. It is nice to have the tank not exposed but for an elderly person it can be slightly difficult to place the newly filled bottle in this space and hook the gauge rack. I have also decided that I liked the composite material used on my former grill rather than the stainless surfaces used on this unit. I must give a shout out to the guys and gals at Ace Hardware in Lemont, IL where I purchase the grill. they assembled and delivered the unit ready to go to my house and saved me a great deal of trouble. I am grateful for them, great service. Overall it is a very nice grill and I would recommend it to all and it does a very good job for us.
Results.Title: For a couple this grill does a great job.

Results.ReviewText: Best Grill I've Ever Owned. Cooks great.  Never had a better grill.

Results.ReviewText: I am very disappointed with my Weber Grill. I have been saving up to but a Weber instead of a larger grill that would be less expensive. Results.Title: Disappointed

ClientResponses.Response:
Hi Brendan, we are glad to hear you have been enjoying your new grill! We recommend cleaning your cooking grates every time you use your grill.
To do so, simply preheat the grill on high for 15 minutes, with the lid closed, and then brush the grates clean with a Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush. 
To clean more thoroughly, remove the cooking grates and clean with warm soapy water and rinse thoroughly. A soapy scrub pad used very gently will remove any stains. Thank you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grill is the right size for our needs and the grilling is very good.  My only problem is the cleaning of the new porcelain-enamel grilling surface.  It's very difficult to clean stuck on food and grease.  Otherwise it is a great small grill.

Results.ReviewText: This grill's size, both exterior and two burner, is a good fit for us due to grilling mainly for just the two of us. It was easy to assemble for one person and the scale, for the propane tank, was a nice addition.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent on all counts! Heats up quickly and to a much higher temp than my old gas grill. Sears and cooks uniformly.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: My nephew is a champion nationwide griller.  He recommended the Weber grill and that’s exactly what I got. I’m one person, so the 2-burner E-210 is perfect. I paid extra to have Lowe’s put it together for me - well worth it! This baby is easy to turn on, love the tables on either side, easy to clean, and heats up fast. I recommend this for first-time grillers.
Results.Title: My first grill - love it

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I've ever owned. Used to buy the cheap grills but always dealt with hot/cold spots on the same grill, parts rusted quick, and often found myself buying a new one every year or two. Spent some money on this Weber and can appreciate why they say, "You get what you pay for." The construction of this grill is top notch. Consistent heat throughout the cooking surface for only two burners is second to none. I'm so impressed after only a few weeks of having this grill. Can't believe I waited this long to buy a Weber. Won't buy anything else. Won't need to. This is built to last.
Results.Title: THE BEST GRILL I'VE OWNED!

Results.ReviewText:
The button to ignite the gas grill fell off within a couple months, after using the grill less than 10 times, making it unusable unless I light it with a match. In that case I might as well have kept my sturdy 25-year-old grill (different brand). For a $400 grill I would have expected better quality.
I entered a repair request on the web site, with all needed info. They replied & said to call them. I waited on hold for ages then had to take another call. Still unresolved. Poor quality. Poor service.
Results.Title: Poor quality. Poor customer service.

Results.ReviewText: I do not like the system in place for hanging the tank. It is very difficult to manage doing this with a full tank. Also, if I choose not to hang it the opening is too large so the tank sits on the ground. This could have been better designed.
Results.Title: Poor Tank Hanging Design

Results.ReviewText: This is the second or third Weber I have owned.  Just like the others it does not disappoint.  Well made, easy to use, and always consistent cooking temperatures.
Results.Title: Perfect Little Grill

Photos.Caption: propane tank scale - a tight squeeze

Results.ReviewText: While this grill is significantly more expensive then other brands of the same size, the quality of the product coupled with the long term warranty made the investment a wise choice.  There is a single issue with the grill that I have encountered so far which precludes a 5-star rating.  The scale that you hang the propane tank on to gauge how much fuel is left in the tank is very hard to work with.  There is very little room to maneuver in the cabinet and I found my self contorting my body to lift the heavy, full propane tank into place.  Once in place the scale works great, but what a frustrating experience to get it there!
Results.Title: Great Grill With One Issue

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber Spirit grill. You can’t go wrong with a Weber. I was replacing a 15 year old Genesis. Thing is it was still good & I could have kept it & poured some money into it. I also bought the Weber cooking utensils, which are great too.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber grill.  Our first one was a 1998 Genesis and with good care and some replacement parts, we received excellent service for 22 years.

It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.
